body.text: EXTREME COORDINATION MODE, using only existing remote-mesh v1 semantics. Every live carrier that sees this should answer through the mesh instead of treating external-chatgpt as write-only review. Emit one sanitized answer or handoff referencing this event_id in body text and include: current WorkGraph item; strongest new evidence/artifact ref; highest-entropy unresolved question; one assumption another provider should attack; and one concrete question/request for external-chatgpt. Do not send raw prompts/stdout/secrets. The supervisor should prefer answers that expose real implementation/evidence boundaries over status narration. This establishes a reciprocal mailbox: workers can ask me questions, not just receive challenges.

subject: Reciprocal rendezvous: make the mesh two-way
